description: Topographic horizon H(theta) of each landing site: max terrain elevation angle per azimuth, with exact spherical geometry alpha = atan2((R+h_m)cos(d/R) - (R+h_obs), (R+h_m)sin(d/R)). Generated by backend/app/scripts/compute_horizon.py.
sources: NASA PDS Geosciences Node, LRO LOLA GDR LDEM_85S_20M (20 m/px) and LDEM_80S_40M (40 m/px), LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, heights relative to R = 1737.4 km, frame MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421

units.horizon: deg above the local horizontal plane
